theorem commutative_cube_lemma 
  {C : Type*} [Category C]
  -- 8 vertices: bottom face (z=0) and top face (z=1)
  {v₀₀₀ v₁₀₀ v₀₁₀ v₁₁₀ v₀₀₁ v₁₀₁ v₀₁₁ v₁₁₁ : C}
  -- Bottom face edges
  (f_bot : v₀₀₀ ⟶ v₁₀₀) (g_bot : v₀₀₀ ⟶ v₀₁₀) 
  (h_bot : v₁₀₀ ⟶ v₁₁₀) (i_bot : v₀₁₀ ⟶ v₁₁₀)
  -- Top face edges
  (f_top : v₀₀₁ ⟶ v₁₀₁) (g_top : v₀₀₁ ⟶ v₀₁₁) 
  (h_top : v₁₀₁ ⟶ v₁₁₁) (i_top : v₀₁₁ ⟶ v₁₁₁)
  -- Vertical edges connecting bottom to top
  (e_v0 : v₀₀₀ ⟶ v₀₀₁) (e_v1 : v₁₀₀ ⟶ v₁₀₁) 
  (e_v2 : v₀₁₀ ⟶ v₀₁₁) (e_v3 : v₁₁₀ ⟶ v₁₁₁)
  -- Five faces commute
  (h_bottom : CommSq f_bot g_bot h_bot i_bot)
  (h_top : CommSq f_top g_top h_top i_top)
  (h_front : CommSq f_bot e_v0 e_v1 f_top)
  (h_back : CommSq g_bot e_v0 e_v2 g_top)
  (h_right : CommSq i_bot e_v2 e_v3 i_top)
  -- One edge out of the source vertex is a monomorphism
  [Mono f_bot]
  -- Then the sixth (left) face also commutes
  : CommSq h_bot e_v1 e_v3 h_top := sorry
